additional_notes: Plot displays SCPTu parameters (qT, fs, ub, and Vs) from 0 to 18 m without explicit soil names or groundwater level text, though the cyan pore pressure baseline starts at 0 kPa at 0 m depth. Pore pressure ub shows high positive values up to ~470 kPa around 1.2-2.8 m and negative values below 3 m with periodic pore water dissipation tests labeled (100, 85, 75, 70, 80, 130, 90, 135, 86, 210, and 345 sec). Shear wave velocity Vs ranges ~200-300 m/s (0-2.8 m), ~160-255 m/s (2.8-14.0 m), and ~190-290 m/s (14.0-18.0 m).
